business_summary: Systematix Corporate Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides merchant banking services in India. The company provides merchant banking services, including open offers/delisting/buy-backs, IPOs/right issues, follow-on public offers, equity/debt placements, valuations, ESOP advisory, and other corporate advisory services. It also offers financing against shares and margin funding services. In addition, the company provides broking, wealth management, portfolio advisory and management services; commodities and currency trading services; and research services. Further, it distributes third party products, such as insurance, mutual funds, and IPO, as well as offers online marketing services. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India. Systematix Corporate Services Limited operates as a subsidiary of Systematix Holdings Private Limited.
